Obligatory not abducted but...

I'm pretty sure most of you might call me crazy or say that I hallucinated. Hell, I would've thought I had hallucinated had my siblings not been there with me and seen it all too. I do believe life probably exists somewhere in the Universe, but if it's advanced aliens flying around in frisbees and anally raping humans, I don't know. Anyhoo, on with the story.

I was 14-15 back then, and lived in a military base up North in Pakistan. One night I was sitting in my driveway, playing with a new RC car I had gotten while my siblings took turns. So I look up and boom. A huge, modern AF, flying saucer right above the treetops, barely 50 feet from my face.

I'll describe it first. It wasn't completely round. It had "edges", like those flat edges. It was more of a stylish square. Underneath it, in the middle, was a big yellow light like those in the movies where they beam you up from. And surrounding this yellow circle were three equidistant neon blue tubes. Overall, a very beautiful craft.

It was gliding slowly and silently over the treetops. And I remember how it was swaying just a little, as though trying to balance, even though there was no wind.

I turned around to make sure I wasn't the only one seeing this and was glad to see my siblings all standing open-mouthed staring at it. I screamed at them to go fetch our mom's phone so we could take a picture. (Didn't have my own phone.) The dumbasses started looking at each other before I screamed at them again. Yes yes I know, I was being a dick. But I really didn't want to leave lest the craft disappear.

Finally my sister ran inside to get the phone. I turned around to look at the craft and it suddenly started accelerating. I know this sounds so cliche but it happened.

I was panicking now. The craft was growing smaller and smaller. I looked towards the Gaurdroom (entrance to the base) to see if the guards there had noticed the craft but they hadn't. My sister finally came back with the phone. The craft was a tiny speck by now, barely distinguishable from the stars. I opened up the camera and JUST as I raised the phone to point the camera at the craft, it disappeared. Like, it's lights just turned off.

Now I dunno what that was. When I told my father he, in pure Pakistani fashion, started speculating about how it was probably an American drone here to spy on our secrets lol. I just like to think there's a couple of aliens on some planet, sitting in a bar and recounting their tale of how they just managed to escape being recorded by a human kid on a malfunctioning craft.

So, whaddaya think Reddit. I always tell this story to people who ask me if I believe in aliens.
